'''2018 European Championship Day 2 Kent Larsen DS Combat Readiness (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Kent Larsen]] at [[2018 European Championship]] (Day 2).

* '''Player:''' [[Kent Larsen]]
* '''Event:''' [[2018 European Championship]]

* '''Stage:''' Day 2
